sloka: ख्यातः प्राज्ञः कृतज्ञश्च सानुक्रोशश्च राघवः ।सद्वृत्तो निरनुक्रोशः शङ्के मद्भाग्यसंक्षयात् ।। ५.२६.१३।।।।
transliteration: khyātaḥ prājñaḥ kṛtajñaśca sānukrośaśca rāghavaḥ ।sadvṛtto niranukrośaḥ śaṅke madbhāgyasaṁkṣayāt ।। 5.26.13।।।।

translations.english: "Rama is renowned, wise, grateful and kindly. It is due to my misfortune that he has turned pitiless to me. There is no doubt.
